description: Soft-reboot a server (graceful ACPI restart) without destroying it or losing data. Use to recover a box that has become unresponsive or to apply changes that need a restart. Requires an account API key (AGENTMETAL_API_KEY) and ownership of the server; without one this returns an auth error. Does not charge money. Returns immediately with status "rebooting"; the box is back in well under a minute.
name: reboot_server
title: Reboot a server
